# README

This dataset consists of PET data using [18F]MK6240 and T1w MRI for a cohort of young to middle-aged healthy individuals. A subset of individuals have a follow up PET scan. 
At osf.io/znt9d, we also include standard uptake value ratio maps normalized to cerebellar grey matter or a composite region of interest (whole cerebellum, brainstem, eroded subcortical white matter) in volume and surface space (fsLR32K). A T1-weighted MNI152 template image in 0.8 x 0.8 x 0.8mm resolution is included for those who wish to transform PET images into MNI152 space (MNI152_T1_0.8mm.nii.gz). Details on how to apply the transformation can be found in the OSF wiki (osf.io/znt9d).

## Details related to access to the data
The dataset can be accessed at: osf.io/znt9d
